Caloria: AI Calorie Counter & Weight Loss Tracker

Track calories, scan food with AI, and understand your nutrition with Caloria, your personal calorie counter and nutrition tracker.

Log meals by taking a photo, using your voice, or entering text. Track daily calories, protein, carbohydrates, fats, and 20+ nutrients while working toward your nutrition goals.

Whether you want to lose weight, maintain your weight, build muscle, or develop healthier eating habits, Caloria makes everyday food tracking simpler.

🔥 AI CALORIE COUNTER & WEIGHT LOSS TRACKER

Set your daily calorie goal and monitor your nutrition with an easy-to-use dashboard.

• Set a personalized calorie target
• Track calories consumed and remaining
• Monitor meals and daily progress
• Review your food diary and history
• Build consistent calorie-tracking habits

🤖 AI FOOD SCANNER

Make food logging faster with AI-powered meal recognition.

📸 Photo logging: Snap a picture of your meal to estimate calories and macros.

🎤 Voice logging: Describe what you ate and log your meal using your voice.

⌨️ Text logging: Type what you ate to create a food entry.

Review and adjust AI-generated estimates before saving. Nutrition values may vary depending on ingredients, portions, and preparation methods.

🥗 FOOD DIARY & MEAL TRACKER

Organize breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks in one place. Review previous meals, understand your eating habits, and see how your food choices fit your daily calorie goals.

💪 MACRO TRACKER: PROTEIN, CARBS & FAT

Track your macronutrients alongside calories.

• Monitor daily protein intake
• Track carbohydrates and fats
• Review meal-level and daily macros
• Follow your nutrition targets

Whether your goal is weight loss, muscle building, or better nutrition, macro tracking helps you understand what you eat.

🥑 TRACK 20+ NUTRIENTS

Go beyond a basic calorie counter. Explore information on 20+ nutrients alongside your calories and macros to better understand your daily nutrition.

🧠 MEET CALI, YOUR AI NUTRITION COACH

Ask Cali about food, calories, meals, macros, and weight-loss goals. Get nutrition guidance based on your goals and tracking activity.

💧 DAILY WATER TRACKER

Track your daily water intake alongside your food and nutrition. Log water, monitor your hydration progress, and keep your daily tracking in one place.
